item.tib: dbang chen gzhung skabs gsal byed las thig gsang ba'i 'grel ba
item.coloph: zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen/ se bon sha ri dbu chen/ me nyag lce tsa mkhar bu/ lde bon gyim tsha dang bzhi yi (yis/)lcags 'phrang bon phug la gter du sbas/ lnga brgya yi mtha' la brdol nas kyang / nyi zer lta bu rgyas par 'gyur/ gter dpe ci bzhin zhal bshus snyo//

item.tib: dbang chen gzhungs skabs gsal byed las thig gsang ba'i 'grel ba
item.coloph: g.yung drung yongs rdzogs pa'i lung don rdzogs so/ 'di mthar rgyas pa rdzogs pa chen po'o/ zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen/ se bon sha ri dbu chen/ me nyag lce tsa mkhar bu/ ldem bon gyim tsha dang bzhi yis/ lcags 'phrang bon phug la gter du sbas/ lnga brgya yi mtha' ma brdol nas kyang / nyi zer lta bu rgyas pa 'gyur/ gter dpe ci bzhin zhal bshus snyo//
